# Tregg Frank — Portfolio

> Portfolio of Tregg Frank, a product designer who designs digital products to be more human and empathetic: product thinking, UX and UX research, UI, interaction design, and design systems.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tre.gg/): Portfolio overview and selected work

- [Contact](https://tre.gg/contact): Contact — hi@tre.gg
- [Side projects](https://tre.gg/side-projects): Side projects and experiments, including Divinate, Unslept.co, Degreeless.Design, and Moral Entropy
